claims.claim: Degree, shortest-path betweenness and eigenvector centrality operationalize different aspects of node importance.
claims.locator: Freeman (1977), network centrality based on betweenness; compare current NetworkX definitions

claims.claim: Betweenness counts fractions of shortest paths between pairs, excluding endpoints by default.
In two triangles connected by a single bridge, its endpoint nodes have normalized undirected betweenness 0.6.
claims.locator: Derived from explicit 6-node 7-edge graph and NetworkX oracle test

claims.claim: Weighted betweenness treats weights as distances and requires appropriate positive weights.
Brandes described more efficient algorithms for computing shortest-path betweenness.
claims.locator: Brandes (2001), A Faster Algorithm for Betweenness Centrality
